name: EPRD Special Needs Summer Day Camp
description_short: A six week city day camp at Pierce Field for young people ages 6 to 21 who need extra support, with sports, games, crafts and weekly bowling and swimming trips.
special_needs_notes: For youth ages 6 to 21 who may need extra support. A medical form with diagnosis, signed by the physician, is required. Campers who cannot manage their own hygiene and toileting, or who need equipment such as oxygen or a feeding tube, attend with an aide.
notes: Camp day 9:30 am to 2:30 pm; extended day 8:30 am to 3:30 pm for $120 for the six weeks. $240 deposit at registration; balance due July 7, 2026. Round trip transportation provided. Weekly bowling and swimming trips; trip fees extra, paid in cash. Rain site: Recreation Center, 610 Waterman Ave.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 special needs camp guidelines PDF: 9:30 am to 2:30 pm, June 22 to July 31, ages 6 to 21, $480 for six weeks, extended day $120, round trip transportation, free lunch
